items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Sheep used to play. You went over with Sheep and her body? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, out in Franklin. She used to go out there in Franklin and play with him on those fairs, Covington too. He played quite a few jobs there with him.

ctx.x: He used to come here and get Sheep to go to the Covington Fair with him.
Yeah, Sheep used to play. You went over with Sheep and her body?
Yeah, out in Franklin. She used to go out there in Franklin and play with him on those fairs, Covington too. He played quite a few jobs there with him.
